mapper.sql: id, provider_account_id AS provider_id, credential_type, encrypted_config, status
mapper.select: select from kb_provider_credentials where provider_account_id = #{providerId} and status = 'ACTIVE' order by id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into kb_provider_credentials(provider_account_id, credential_type, encrypted_config, status) values(#{providerId}, #{credentialType}, #{encryptedConfig}, #{status})
mapper.update: update kb_provider_credentials set status = 'INACTIVE', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where provider_account_id = #{providerId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
